item.title: AI-supported emergency triage improves accuracy and patient flow
item.description: Taylor and colleagues assessed an AI-informed triage decision-support tool. Nurses using the tool identified patient acuity more accurately, improving overall triage performance.

item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind September 21, 2026
item.description: Respiratory syncytial virus-related hospitalizations among infants receiving nirsevimab. A large case-control study across seven tertiary pediatric centers examined outcomes.

item.title: Longevity Roundup: Sleep and biological aging, menopause and cognition, diet and mortality, frailty mobility
item.description: Sleep quality and regularity are linked to biological aging across multiple systems. Sleep duration alone may offer an incomplete picture of sleep health.

item.title: Setting boundaries as a physician does not mean caring less
item.description: For years I believed good doctors always said yes. Can you see one more patient? Yes. Can you answer this message before leaving? Of course.
